def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def f9(value):
    return [value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid,
            value.st_nlink, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns]


def read(path, cap=32 * 1024**2):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path, 'canonical complete source input')
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid == before.st_gid == 1000
             and before.st_nlink == 1 and 0 <= before.st_size <= cap, 'bounded exact source input')
        with os.fdopen(os.dup(fd), 'rb') as stream:
            raw = stream.read(cap + 1)
        need(len(raw) == before.st_size and f9(before) == f9(os.fstat(fd)) == f9(path.lstat()),
             'complete held/named source input')
        return raw
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def ref(path):
    raw = read(path)
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'identity': f9(Path(path).lstat())}


def put(path, raw):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o400)
    try:
        view = memoryview(raw)
        while view:
            count = os.write(fd, view)
            need(count > 0, 'whole independent publication')
            view = view[count:]
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    need(read(path) == raw, 'whole independent publication readback')
    return ref(path)

    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = value
    spec.loader.exec_module(value)
    return value
